country_count.note: Counted from the six places named; Wikipedia does not itself state a country count number, and 'Taiwan (Republic of China)' may or may not be counted separately from China depending on convention. The author affiliations of the final Daya Bay paper (arXiv:2211.14988, 2022) are in mainland China, Taiwan, Hong Kong, the United States, the Czech Republic and Russia (JINR Dubna), with no Chilean institution, so the set of places differs between sources.
country_count.quote: researchers from China, Chile, the United States, Taiwan (Republic of China), Russia, and the Czech Republic

institution_count.note: Counted from the numbered affiliations (1-42, all distinct institutions) in the author list of the final Daya Bay oscillation paper, arXiv:2211.14988 (dated 29 November 2022). This is a count of listed author affiliations, not an official membership figure; no official collaboration page was reachable (dayabay.ihep.ac.cn is unreachable). The earlier value 40 ('40+ institutional collaborators') could not be found in the cached Wikipedia text.
institution_count.quote: 41 Iowa State University, Ames, Iowa 50011 42 Chongqing University, Chongqing

name: Daya Bay Collaboration
notes: The country count relies on Wikipedia (rank 12); the institution count is counted from the final Daya Bay paper's author affiliations. The official experiment site (dayabay.ihep.ac.cn) timed out on every attempt (checked 2026-09-17), so counts from the collaboration's own page could not be obtained.
No institution-level member list or leadership list is recorded in the Atlas for this collaboration.

summary.plain: The international team of scientists from China and several other countries who built and ran the Daya Bay reactor-neutrino experiment.
summary.technical: International collaboration operating the Daya Bay reactor-antineutrino experiment; per Wikipedia, researchers from China, Chile, the United States, Taiwan, Russia and the Czech Republic across 40+ institutions.
